description: Create an unsigned FreeSign draft when the user has a locally computed PDF SHA-256 hash and wants a signing link for that document. If no computed hash is available, the user can start directly at https://free-sign.com/ and select their PDF there without calculating a hash themselves. Do not invent a hash. Returns a signing link; the user opens it and selects the matching local PDF to continue. Creating a draft does not sign a document or send email. This tool does not upload PDF bytes to FreeSign; signing requires a browser session key, identity verification, and explicit consent.

document_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original PDF bytes, computed locally by the user or agent.

name: create_signing_envelope

session_binding_required.description: True when the envelope still needs the browser to call /api/envelopes/{id}/session-bind. Always true for MCP-created envelopes.

title: Create signing envelope
